$note: Style-lock presets (docs/design/art-direction-study.md). Distances in px are for a 1024 px canvas and scale with the image. L and C are CIELAB lightness and chroma. Change a value only with a before/after contact sheet in the PR. lock-light is the default: saturation, contrast and the value range are graded at runtime by PofuWorld's WorldGrade, so the files keep them near neutral and the look stays reversible.

lock-light.$note: The default since 2026-11-02 (look-dev): bake only what must be baked. A soft toe keeps the darkest shadow off near-black without compressing mids or highs; the detail budget, the green and red hue fixes, the alpha snap and the edge feather stay. Saturation and contrast stay near neutral; WorldGrade shapes them at runtime.

plate-final.$note: Kind plate (ADR-0023): the painting is the final colour and contrast, so nothing is clamped, lifted or blurred. Only the alpha snap and the edge feather stay. Replaces lock-light for plates; earlier notes that lock-light keeps files near neutral do not apply to plates.

soft-lock.$note: The default until 2026-11-02, kept for comparison and to re-lock old masters: A's grade and clamps plus a light share of B's simplification. No grain, no posterization, no outline.

harmonize.$note: Study treatment A: grade and clamp toward R1, a shared fine grain, a soft edge. Shapes and texture untouched.

gouache.$note: Study treatment B: edge-preserving simplification, Kuwahara patches, six soft value steps, a brush-scale grain.

storybook.$note: Study treatment C: flat color blocks (k-means in CIELAB) with one shadow tone and a soft colored outline.

char-guard.$note: Characters keep their fur detail: only the alpha snap and a high chroma guard, so a drifting take cannot slip past QA by being locked.
